_comment: Example sweep manifest — copy this shape for new work.
Expand it into cells:  python scripts/dispatch/queue.py expand configs/dispatch/example_probe_sweep.json --dry-run
Everything the worker needs is here; the worker itself never changes.
Every arg is a real scripts/run_experiment.py flag (tests/test_dispatch.py checks this against its argparse).
run_experiment.py writes <out-dir>/aggregate_metrics.json plus seed_<N>/metrics.json, hence the output_check.
cell_id_hash puts a fingerprint of the args in each cell id, so editing args later makes new cells instead of a conflict.
name: gsm8k_probe_sweep
